video_acceptance: REQUIRED: confirm no visible rendering defects and the intended footage is present
opening_acceptance: REQUIRED: inspect the opening two seconds for an effective, accurate hook
aspect_ratio_acceptance: REQUIRED: confirm the actual rendered dimensions/aspect ratio fit the selected platform
captions_acceptance: REQUIRED: inspect caption/subtitle visibility, readability, timing, spelling, and safe-area placement
ending_acceptance: REQUIRED: confirm the ending/payoff is present and not cut off
audio_acceptance: REQUIRED: confirm audio presence when expected, intelligibility, sync, levels, and no audible defects
rights_acceptance: REQUIRED: confirm rights/provenance evidence is acceptable for the intended use
